📖 How to use

  1. Enter amount, rate and term (years) for each of the three loans.
  2. Compare monthly payment, total interest and total cost in the table.
  3. Pick the loan highlighted as the cheapest overall.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which loan is the cheapest?

The cheapest loan is the one with the lowest total cost (principal plus all interest). A lower monthly payment does not always mean a cheaper loan.

Are fees included in the comparison?

Only principal and interest are compared. Origination fees, points and other charges are not included unless you add them to the loan amount.

Why would a longer term be more expensive?

A longer term lowers the monthly payment but usually increases total interest. This table lets you see both effects at once.
